reflection_journal_prompts: What leadership behavior had the greatest positive impact this week and why?
Where did I avoid a difficult conversation and what was the consequence?
How did I build trust across stakeholders this week?
What am I learning about my leadership identity?
How well am I balancing stewardship of today with preparation for the future?
What feedback did I receive and how will I apply it?
